timing: Shared and deduplicated candidate search; no independent per-arm speed claims
budget_rule: Inner mean F1 >= full - .01; minimize rho*k/d, then k, maximize F1, frozen candidate ID; tolerance 1e-12
purpose: Prospectively frozen development comparison; execution is a later A2 task
scientific_scope: Five outer development folds; all arms share data, grids, model seeds, candidate score table; not independent confirmation
M_rationale: Prospectively bounded high-dimensional extension; M64 is not claimed accurate because HTRU2 M256 passed
replay: one complete outer fold in separate replay directory using the same dataset ledger
audit: independent integrity and selected direct refits; reserve included in hard caps
audit_rule: For every game choose smallest proper nonempty cached mask, independent of utility; refit 3 folds. Refit 8 final arms in each of 5 main and 1 replay fold. Same cumulative ledger.
